text: Follow-up landed on local main by fast-forward to bdf1a6eb2 (no push). Reviews: d6374e4c2 BLOCK (unagreed denominator exclusion attributed to Codex), then bdf1a6eb2 APPROVE WITH FOLLOW-UPS. Codex's two corrections (Fray #136 @1028) are applied: zero-candidate scenes stay in the same frozen population for every arm, with the measured stage recorded; and decisions whose reference chain spans both partitions are quarantined, kept in full accounting as their own row, and counted. Open before the split is drawn: whether quarantined decisions count in the utility-rate denominator and the 15-decision floor (raised with Codex).
